<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Business and economy
*French authorities impound a [[Ryanair]] jet, because of payments owed to the [[European Union]] for illegal subsidies, at the [[Bordeaux–Mérignac Airport]] just before 149 London-bound passengers boarded. [https://www.apnews.com/2f2ac67b6fd44fc4873d20942b61e653 (AP)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[2018 California wildfires]]
**[[Camp Fire (2018)|Camp Fire]]
***Evacuations are prompted in [[Butte County, California]], after the [[Camp Fire (2018)|Camp Fire]] erupts. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/paradise-camp-fire-in-butte-county-california-forces-evacuations-today-2018-11-08/ (CBS News)]
***The [[Honey Run Covered Bridge]] that crosses [[Butte Creek (Butte County, California)|Butte Creek]] is destroyed by the [[wildfire]]. It was said to be the last surviving three-span [[timber bridge|timber]] [[Truss bridge#Pratt truss|pratt-type]] [[covered bridge]]. [https://www.chicoer.com/2018/11/09/honey-run-covered-bridge-destroyed-by-fire/amp/ (''Chico Enterprise-Record'')] [https://www.sfgate.com/california-wildfires/article/honey-run-covered-bridge-destroyed-chico-fire-13379409.php (''SFGate'')]
*[[Royal Norwegian Navy]] frigate [[HNoMS Helge Ingstad (F313)|HNoMS ''Helge Ingstad'']] collides with a [[Malta|Maltese]] oil tanker in the [[Hjeltefjorden|Heltefjord]] while returning from [[NATO]] military exercises, prompting the evacuation of all 137 crew members. Seven sailors were injured in the collision. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-46136564 (BBC)]

;Law and crime
*Police in [[Ethiopia]] say they have discovered a mass grave with 200 bodies near the border between the [[Somali Region|Somali]] and [[Oromia region]]s of the country. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-46145307 (BBC)]
*The [[Mossos d'Esquadra]] announces that on September 19, 2018, they arrested a man planning to assassinate the [[Prime Minister of Spain]] [[Pedro Sánchez]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-46138158 (BBC)] [https://www.nytimes.com/aponline/2018/11/08/world/europe/ap-eu-spain-foiled-attack.html (''The New York Times'')] 
*A riot at a high-security prison in [[Khujand]], [[Tajikistan]], known for holding convicted terrorists, including [[Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant|ISIL]] members, leaves at least 27 people dead. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-tajikistan-khujand/at-least-27-killed-in-tajikistan-prison-riot-security-sources-idUSKCN1ND0IX (Reuters)]
*A federal judge in [[Montana]] orders a suspension of construction on the [[Keystone Pipeline#Keystone XL|Keystone XL]] pipeline, citing an inadequate review of the potential environmental impact of the pipeline. [https://www.npr.org/2018/11/09/665994751/judge-puts-keystone-xl-pipeline-on-hold-pending-further-environmental-study (NPR)] [https://eu.greatfallstribune.com/story/news/2018/11/08/judge-blocks-construction-keystone-xl-pipeline-montana-fort-peck-climate-chagne/1938114002/ (''Great Falls Tribune'')] 

;Politics and elections
*[[White House Press Secretary]] [[Sarah Huckabee Sanders]] receives widespread condemnation after tweeting an allegedly altered video from a press conference the day before. The video, which was allegedly doctored by the [[Far-right politics|far-right]] conspiracy website [[InfoWars]], is claimed to falsely depict [[CNN]]'s [[White House]] correspondent [[Jim Acosta]] physically assaulting an intern. [https://news.sky.com/story/white-house-press-secretary-accused-of-sharing-fake-video-of-cnn-reporter-row-11548674 (Sky News)] [https://www.huffingtonpost.co.uk/entry/people-call-for-sarah-huckabee-sanders-to-resign-for-jim-acosta-video_us_5be448e6e4b0dbe871a8109d (''HuffPost'' UK)]

;Science and technology
*[[2018 in science]]
**[[NASA]]'s [[Chandra X-ray Observatory]] confirms earlier observations by [[Indian Space Research Organisation]]'s [[Astrosat]] space observatory of a [[rotating black hole]] in the [[binary star system]] [[List of microquasars|4U1630-47]], which is spinning close to the [[speed of light]], one of the fastest ever observed. [https://www.indiatoday.in/education-today/gk-current-affairs/story/indian-satellite-astrosat-helps-find-black-hole-spinning-near-maximum-possible-rates-1380893-2018-11-02 (''India Today'')] [https://metro.co.uk/2018/11/08/astronomers-found-a-black-hole-rotating-so-fast-its-sucking-up-space-itself-8117430/ (''Metro'')]
**A new study from [[Eötvös Loránd University]] confirms the existence of two [[Kordylewski cloud]]s orbiting [[Earth]]. [[Kazimierz Kordylewski]] first observed the faint clouds of dust around the {{L4}} and {{L5}} [[Lagrangian point]]s in the 1960s. [https://www.indiatimes.com/technology/science-and-future/scientists-now-say-earth-has-two-extra-moons-made-entirely-of-dust-clouds-356300.html (''India Times'')] [https://www.inquisitr.com/5150418/new-discovery-earth-officially-has-three-moons/ (Inquisitr)]
*[[Automated journalism]]
**[[China]]'s [[Xinhua News Agency]] unveils the world's first [[Artificial intelligence|AI]] news anchor. Xinhua says the AI presenters can work "24 hours a day", thus reducing news production costs. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/technology-46136504 (BBC)]
